title: Tool layer, MCP configuration and output controls
statement: Tool layer, MCP configuration and output controls
body: Proposed for approval: - Adopt [tool-registry.json](../../harness/tools/tool-registry.json) as the single inventory. An enabled MCP tool must be read-only; a tool that mutates remote state or needs sign-in cannot be enabled for agents; a disabled tool must be reachable by no agent. These are checked by `validate-tools`. - Enable `greenfuel-tools` (local, zero dependencies, 13 read-only tools) and `microsoft-learn` (remote, no authentication, three read-only tools, `azure-platform` only). - Keep `azure-mcp` (pinned to 3.0.0 with its integrity hash) and `github-mcp-server` as **pending-approval candidates** in a file no client reads. Approving one follows the procedure in MCP-SECURITY. - Add `tool-output-guard.cjs` as a repository-wide `postToolUse` hook: redact secret-shaped text, strip hidden characters, cap size, mark external content untrusted, write a metadata-only audit log. - Extend `agent-guard.cjs` to deny any MCP tool not granted to the calling agent, matched by exact name (a lookalike server name or an unlisted tool is never the registered one), to allow read-type native tools by exact name only, and to limit web fetch to exact approved https hosts. Extend the repository-wide `policy-guard.cjs` to refuse, in any session, an unlisted tool of an enabled server (VS Code has no native tool filter). - Add nine deterministic validators over specifications, candidate contracts (`v0-candidate`) and synthetic fixtures. They report EMPTY when nothing exists to check. - No Azure or GitHub sign-in, no server installation and no remote change is part of this decision.
subject: adr.0007
